text:
Jamie (People Ops): Hey — quick Q: where can I pull up my digital insurance card? Need to show it at a pharmacy today. @Sana R. any quick link?
HR Support Bot: Hi Jamie 👋 Your carrier card is available via the Benefits Portal under "My Benefits" -> "Insurance Cards". Here's the link: https://benefits.redwood.com/insurance-cards (works SSO). If offline, call 1-800-555-1212.
Sana R.: Calling out quick steps: 1) go to benefits portal, 2) click plan tile (Medical - BluePeak HMO), 3) click 'View ID card' and choose family member if needed. If the card doesn't load, DM me and I'll generate a PDF.
Alex H.: Thanks! Do I need the member ID or policy number? Pharmacy is asking for 'BIN/PCN' fields too.
Sana R.: Member ID is usually fine. For retail pharmacy they often want BIN, PCN, Group — those are on the front of the digital card. If you only have member ID, ask the pharmacist to look up by name + DOB and employer (Redwood).
Jamie (People Ops): I see the card but BIN/PCN fields are blank. Is that expected?
Sana R.: Some plans obfuscate BIN/PCN for HMO plans in portal view. If blank, use the 'Download PDF' option — the PDF has full routing fields. If still missing, send me the last 3 digits of your member ID and I can verify with carrier.
Ben L.: FYI if anyone needs to add spouse/newborn: benefits portal -> dependents -> upload birth certificate/SSN. Enrollment changes take 48–72 hours to reflect on ID cards.
Alex H.: Appreciate it. I had to show proof for an urgent med; pharmacist accepted name + employer + DOB. Saved the PDF to phone. :thumbsup:
Sana R.: Great. Filing note: if you submit a claim and it gets denied for 'out of network' because provider used wrong BIN, ping me and we'll correct with carrier — usually a quick carrier fix with the claim reference.
Jamie (People Ops): Thanks all! Saved the link and PDF. Closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
